interpretation: VERIFIED = the quotation occurs at (or within a few lines of) a line reference written on the quotation's own markdown line or on the line above/below it inside the same block. Both citation styles are read: `line N` / `(N)` and the registers' declared house style `§11.9 1613–1617`, `G.2 3672`, `Directive 194`. LINE_OFF = genuine quotation, right file, wrong line number. LINE_OFF_OTHER_SOURCE = the quotation exists in a different reference file than the line attributes it to. SELF_RECORDING = the quoted text is a value this project recorded in its own audit registers, or a cell of the Owner's gap-closure register; those carry no requirement line number, so this is a class, not a defect. DEFINED_TERM = a short (≤ 8 token) controlled-vocabulary label with no nearby number, where this same document cites the exact source line the label was found on — the term is anchored once at its definition and repeated as vocabulary, which is not a missing citation. NOT_FOUND = no requirement source contains the quotation; treat as suspect and either restore the source wording or rewrite it as a paraphrase without quotation marks. NO_LINE_REFERENCE = quoted material with no nearby line number, which includes this repository's own vocabulary and is not a citation; when it is verbatim requirement text it is additionally listed as uncited verbatim. Elided quotations (ellipsis or bracketed note) are matched by their surviving runs in order inside a three-line window, so an honest truncated quote is not mistaken for a fabricated one. Quoted strings of fewer than three tokens are skipped (summary.unmatched). SEPARATELY, summary.bareRefs counts the line references that sit on lines carrying no quotation at all — citations made by paraphrase plus number, which the quotation pass cannot see. Each is tested for the claims a number makes without any text to match: REF_PAST_END (no bindable source is that long), REF_BLANK_TARGET (the line named is empty in every candidate), REF_SECTION_MISMATCH (the citation names a section that its source has, and the line lies outside it), REF_SECTION_UNKNOWN (the citation names a section absent from every bindable structured source). These are defects, not classes: a line reference that does not resolve, or that puts a line inside the wrong section, is a citation this repository cannot stand behind. What no check here asserts is that the paraphrase summarises the line correctly — that needs the text or a reader, and neither is simulated. A bare parenthesised `(N)` is excluded from this pass on quote-less lines, where it is indistinguishable from a year or a quantity.
